max_cps.source: CAPTION-PROTOCOL.md §2 ('≤~20 karakter/sn'); enforced at exactly 20.0 — interpretation of '~'

no_split_numbers_names.source: CAPTION-PROTOCOL.md §2 (sayı ve ismin ortasından bölme yok)

break_at_sentence_or_meaning.source: CAPTION-PROTOCOL.md §2 (cümle/anlam sınırında böl) — not machine-measurable; applied as segmentation cost

silence_split_ms.source: internal default: speech pause ≥ this forces a new cue

hold_ms.source: internal default: cue stays up to this long after the last word

long_gap_warn_ms.source: internal default: warn on gaps between cues longer than this

video_duration_tolerance_ms.source: internal default: allowed difference between supplied video_duration_s and --video measurement

auto_protect_caps_max_tokens.source: internal default: adjacent capitalised words (2..N) are kept on one line
